records.details: Selected Microsoft Edge row enables Open selected folder before filtering; no folder/scan action dispatched. Live DPI observer active, raw collection pending.
Filtering selected Edge with z leaves zero rows and disables Open selected folder, clearing stale selected-row action. No scan/folder action. Live DPI collection pending.
Clearing filter restores Edge results while Open selected folder remains disabled until a new explicit selection; stale selection not revived. No new scan or folder dispatch.
